dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: It's just like the book says... "Under the influence of the Jinn, though the land was as a barren desert, it would grow into a verdant oasis..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look at that. Isn't there something shiny under that big tree? Could that be the Jinni we're looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Careful, Paimon! We're not sure if this place is safe yet!
